readOnly.title: Read-only
readOnly.body: You can review these settings, but changing them requires the {{role}} role.

secret.onceBody: Copy the secret now and store it in a safe place. After you close this dialog it cannot be displayed again — you would have to create a new one.

general.publicNameHint: Shown in the global rating instead of the tenant name. Leave empty to stay anonymous there.
general.slugHint: Part of every URL and API path (/t/{slug}). It cannot be changed.
general.retentionHint: Finished runs, their logs and metrics are deleted after this many days. Tenant limit: {{max}} days.
general.retentionMax: At most {{max}} days — the tenant limit
general.defaultKeepHint: How long a stand stays alive after a run finishes unless overridden at launch. 0s = tear down immediately; limit {{max}}.
general.ratingTenantHint: New runs take part in the tenant rating unless switched off at launch.
general.ratingGlobalHint: New runs are submitted to the public rating under the public name.
general.emailsHint: Extra recipients for run/suite notifications in addition to personal preferences. Press Enter after each address.
general.transferHint: Hand the tenant over to another member. You will become an admin.
general.transferNoMembers: Invite another member first — only members can receive ownership.
general.transferWarnTitle: You will lose the owner role
general.transferWarnBody: Only the owner can delete the tenant or transfer it again. The new owner must not already own another tenant.
general.deleteHint: Deletes all runs, tests, databases, providers and members of this tenant. Only possible when no run is live.
general.deleteBody: Everything in this tenant — runs and their results, library, provider profiles, tokens, webhooks — will be removed and cannot be restored. Live runs must be cancelled first, otherwise the server refuses.

members.ownerImmutable: The owner role is changed only via transfer of ownership.
members.removeBody: They lose access immediately; their personal tokens for this tenant stop working. Their runs and objects stay.
members.leaveBody: You lose access immediately. Ask an admin for a new invite to come back.
members.noInvitesHint: Invite people by e-mail — they join with the chosen role on first login.
members.inviteHint: The invite is valid for 7 days. If the person has no account yet it is applied on their first login.
members.roleHint: Owner cannot be granted here — use transfer of ownership.

roleDesc.member: Library and launching runs; cancels only own runs

members.messagePlaceholder: Optional note included in the e-mail
members.revokeBody: The link in the e-mail stops working. You can send a new invite later.
members.ownerCantLeave: The owner cannot leave — transfer ownership first
members.notPending: The invite is no longer pending

providers.title: Provider profiles
providers.hint: A profile = cloud credentials + placement (cloud/folder/zone or region). Every run picks a profile explicitly; only verified (ready) profiles can launch.
providers.emptyHint: Add a Yandex Cloud or AWS profile to launch runs on real machines.
providers.staleHint: Older than the freshness window (1 min). Refresh happens automatically before launch.
providers.verifyingHint: The stroppy-provider-verify pipeline is checking the credentials and permissions. Usually takes under a minute.
providers.failedHint: Verification failed. Fix the credentials and verify again.
providers.readyHint: Credentials verified; the profile can be used in runs.
providers.deleteBody: Tests and suites referencing this profile will need another one before launch. Its credentials are removed from Graphene. Not possible while a live run uses it.
providers.kindHint: Pick the cloud. Settings and credentials forms depend on it.
providers.settingsHint: Non-secret placement: where machines are created. Stored as-is and shown on the profile card.
providers.credentialsHint: Credentials go straight to Graphene's secret store and are never returned by the API. To rotate them later use Edit → Replace credentials.
providers.schemaMissing: The form schema for this provider is unavailable — try again later.
providers.name: Profile name
providers.nameHint: Unique within the tenant; shown in launch forms and run summaries.
providers.afterCreateBody: The profile is created in the verifying state. A pipeline checks the credentials and reads the cloud quotas; the card updates to ready or failed with a reason.
providers.savedReverify: Profile saved — credentials replaced, verification started
providers.replaceCredentialsHint: Current secrets stay untouched unless you enable this. New credentials trigger a fresh verification.

quotas.hint: Cloud quotas per profile as observed by the stroppy-quotas pipeline. Before a launch the server checks the RunSpec against this cache (refreshed when older than a minute).
quotas.noProviders: No provider profiles — quotas appear once a profile is ready.
quotas.unavailableGeneric: The cloud did not return quotas for this profile. Launches skip the precheck and rely on the provider's own limits.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.hint: HTTPS endpoints receiving Standard Webhooks (HMAC-SHA256 signed) for run and suite events. Failed deliveries retry with backoff and can be replayed.
webhooks.emptyHint: Notify CI, chat or your own service when runs finish.
webhooks.urlHint: Must be https://. The endpoint should answer 2xx within 10 s.
webhooks.eventsHint: Which events to send. run.stage fires on every phase change.
webhooks.secretNote: A signing secret is generated on create and shown once.
webhooks.secretHint: Use it to verify the webhook-signature header of requests sent to {{url}}.
webhooks.rotateBody: The current secret stops validating immediately. Update the receiver with the new secret right after.
webhooks.deleteBody: {{url}} will no longer receive events. Delivery history is removed.
webhooks.deliveriesHint: Latest first. Replay sends the same payload again as a new delivery.

tokens.title: Service tokens
tokens.hint: Tenant-level tokens for CI and automation. They are not tied to a person and stay valid when members leave.
tokens.nameHint: Where the token is used — helps to find and revoke it later.
tokens.roleHint: Service tokens can be member (launch runs) or viewer (read-only).
tokens.expiresHint: Optional. Leave empty for a token that never expires.
tokens.expiresFuture: Expiry must be in the future
tokens.emptyHint: Create one to launch runs from CI with stroppy-cloud CLI or the API.
tokens.revokeBody: Requests with this token start failing with 401 immediately.

audit.noTargetLink: The target has no page of its own

limits.title: Limits
limits.aboutBody: These limits are set by the platform (or overridden by a platform admin for this tenant) and cannot be changed here. Launches that exceed them are rejected at validation.
limits.overrideNote: A platform admin set custom limits for this tenant; changes to platform defaults do not apply here.
limits.defaultNote: This tenant follows the platform defaults; contact a platform admin to raise a limit.

table.noPermission: Your role does not allow this action
